flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.desc: A scuffed flashlight. Beam is weak but determined.

field_radio.name: Field Radio
field_radio.desc: Forest Service-style handheld. It hisses like it knows secrets.

ranger_key.name: Ranger Key
ranger_key.desc: A brass key labeled 'STATION'. Smells faintly of cedar oil.

plaster_kit.name: Plaster Cast Kit
plaster_kit.desc: A small field kit for casting tracks. Heavy, but worth it.

evidence_bag.name: Evidence Bag
evidence_bag.desc: A zip bag with a TORCHLIGHT sticker. Official enough.

audio_tape.name: Microcassette Tape
audio_tape.desc: A labeled tape: 'RIDGE CALLS — DO NOT PLAY ALONE'.

trailhead.name: Cedar Ridge Trailhead
trailhead.desc:
Rain taps the hood of your truck. Fir trees loom. A trail sign reads:
  CEDAR RIDGE — 4.2 MI — STAY ON TRAIL
A faded warning sticker: 'SQUATCHPATROL — REPORT ANOMALIES'.

creek.name: Cold Creek
creek.desc:
A narrow creek cuts through mossy rock. The water is clear.
Something on the bank looks like a disturbance… or a message.

logging_road.name: Old Logging Road
logging_road.desc:
A muddy service road half-reclaimed by salal. Tire ruts are old.
But the footprints beside them are… not.
The air smells like wet cedar and ozone.

lock_messages.east: THE RANGER STATION DOOR IS CHAINED. YOU'D NEED A KEY… OR A VERY BAD IDEA.

cedar_grove.name: Cedar Grove
cedar_grove.desc:
Giant cedars rise like pillars. The canopy dims everything.
You hear a knock—wood on wood—three times.
Then silence.

lookout_gate.name: Lookout Gate
lookout_gate.desc:
A steel gate blocks the last climb to the ridge lookout.
A posted note reads: 'CLOSED — RADIO INTERFERENCE'.
A keypad box is wired to an ancient receiver.

lock_messages.north: THE GATE WON'T BUDGE. THE KEYPAD BLINKS: 'SYNC RADIO FIRST'.

ranger_station.name: Ranger Station (Abandoned)
ranger_station.desc:
A small station building. Dusty maps on the wall. A radio console hums.
A note is taped to the console:
  'CALIBRATE HANDHELD TO 107.7 — THEN OPEN THE RIDGE'.

ridge_lookout.name: Ridge Lookout
ridge_lookout.desc:
You emerge into wind and fog. A lookout tower silhouette stands ahead.
Inside the shack, a terminal glows with a single line:
  FILE REPORT TO CLOSE CASE.
Outside, something massive shifts the trees downhill.

uses.add_log: Found station key at Cedar Grove. Chain cut avoided. Door now accessible.
uses.out: YOU UNLOCK THE CHAINED DOOR. IT DROPS WITH A CLATTER. THE STATION IS OPEN.

uses.add_log: Radio calibrated at Ranger Station per note (107.7). Interference reduced.
uses.out: YOU TUNE THE RADIO TO 107.7. THE STATIC THINS. A LOW VOICE WHISPERS: '…RIDGE…'.

uses.add_log: Lookout gate opened after radio sync. Proceeding to ridge lookout.
uses.out: THE KEYPAD BEEPS ONCE. THE GATE MOTOR GRINDS, THEN OPENS. THE RIDGE IS CLEAR.

uses.add_log: Filed report with tape evidence. Case closed pending further review.
uses.out:
YOU SLIDE THE TAPE INTO THE TERMINAL'S PLAYER.
THE SCREEN FLICKERS:
  REPORT RECEIVED.
  EVIDENCE ATTACHED.
  CASE STATUS: CLOSED.

YOU WIN.
(TYPE 'RESTART' TO RUN THE CASE AGAIN.)
